The company has market cap of 74.80 million GBP. The firm offers various leadership services, including executive search that supports multinational organizations and companies to attract, recruit, and retain outstanding board members, top executives, senior management, and leaders; interim management consultancy services; and strategic leadership services, such as board evaluations, management development, audits, assessments, and strategic HR consulting. It has a 21.86 P/E ratio. It also provides digital specialist recruitment services on a flexible or permanent basis; payroll services; and recruitment process outsourcing services. Maria Brooks
